label: Israel and Palestine
rule: Counted: every recorded U.S. House vote from January 3, 2023 through October 17, 2026 on passing a bill or joint resolution whose main purpose is military or security aid, weapons or arms sales for Israel, or limiting, conditioning or blocking them (including passage under suspension of the rules, agreeing to Senate changes and veto overrides), and every recorded vote on an amendment whose official description would add, cut, condition or bar military aid, weapons or arms transfers to Israel. Not counted: procedural votes, final passage of broad bills such as the annual defense bill or full-year spending bills, resolutions that state a position without funding or arms provisions, and measures that apply to every country without naming Israel. Everything considered and not counted is listed.
scopeNote: Military aid and arms sales are decided by Congress, so this list has U.S. House votes only; state and local officials have no votes on it.
voteNote: Votes are as recorded by the Clerk of the House. On amendment votes taken in the Committee of the Whole the Clerk prints Aye and No; they are shown here as Yea and Nay.
